headline: Approved one-day liquor license for Malden Chamber of Commerce's Pints on Pleasant event, 3-0.
summary: The board approved the minutes from the February 24, 2026 meeting. It also reviewed and approved a one-day liquor license application from the Malden Chamber of Commerce for the Pints on Pleasant event, to be held in City Hall Plaza on May 16, 2026 from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
decisions: Approved a One-Day License for Malden Chamber of Commerce for the Pints on Pleasant Event on May 16, 2026, 3 Yea 0 Nay.

Malden Chamber of Commerce. The One Day License is for the Pints on 
Pleasant Event to be held in City Hall Plaza on May 16, 2026 from 
1:00PM to 5:00PM. The board voted to approve the One-Day License.
